moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty, who had to be helped off the practice field today, is believed to have sprained his ankle… not considered a long‑term injury

moments.author: Marjorie Taylor Greene
moments.quote: Now Trump is going to buy 300,000 metric tons of ground beef apparently from Argentina undercutting the American cattlemen.
moments.why: Republican outrage is skyrocketing — she’s framing it as betrayal of U.S. farmers by Trump concessions.
